title: Intelligent Soil Analyzer and Crop Fertilizers Advisory System

source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: MUST is developing sensor-based soil analysis and a random-forest advisory model. Yield improvements and lower fertilizer waste remain intended. Soil-analysis system development.

system: Intelligent soil analyzer and crop-fertilizer advisory system

ratings.reason: Farmers are intended to improve fertilizer choices and yield.
Lower fertilizer overuse and healthier soils are intended benefits, not documented environmental changes.
